snippet.title: Frostpunk 2 | Console Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Pre-Order #Frostpunk 2 now on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP4361-PPSA16608_00-0409272951672325
❄️Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/frostpunk-2/9N0KN24FWP6B

The eagerly awaited console premiere of #Frostpunk 2 is set to arrive on September 18 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with controller support also coming to PC ❄️

Face hardships, tough decisions, ideological conflicts, and lead your people to a brighter future as #TheCityMustNotFall.
